evidence.title: Red-dyed diesel: What is it, and can you use the tax-free fuel?

occurrences.checkable_against: Fuel sales records and applicable off-road diesel rules
occurrences.quote_span: Red-dyed fuel is already available to farmers, for example, who use it for off-road use, explains Patrick De Haan of GasBuddy, a platform that monitors national gasoline and diesel prices.
occurrences.speaker: Patrick De Haan
occurrences.subject: Red-dyed diesel

occurrences.checkable_against: White House fact sheet on dyed diesel
occurrences.quote_span: The coloring also helps “law enforcement … identify it to enforce penalties and back taxes for on-road use,” a fact sheet from the White House explains.
occurrences.speaker: White House
occurrences.subject: Red-dyed diesel

occurrences.checkable_against: North Dakota dyed diesel tax statute
occurrences.quote_span: North Dakota, for example, has a tax of 4 cents per gallon on dyed diesel.

occurrences.subject: Red-dyed diesel

occurrences.checkable_against: Commercial Fueling Network off-road diesel location map

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal dyed diesel tax statute and state excise-tax rules

occurrences.checkable_against: Washington State Department of Licensing rules

evidence.title: Trump temporarily expands use of red-dyed diesel. Will it lower costs?

occurrences.checkable_against: Executive order text and federal diesel tax regulations
occurrences.quote_span: Mr. Trump's executive order temporarily removes the limits on red-dyed diesel, allowing all drivers to use it without incurring taxes or penalties. However, it doesn't entirely eliminate taxes on red-dyed diesel.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Red-dyed diesel

occurrences.checkable_against: Executive order text and White House implementation directive
occurrences.quote_span: Instead, it defers the federal excise tax for the remainder of 2026 and directs the Treasury secretary to explore ways to eliminate the requirement to pay the taxes, according to the White House.
occurrences.speaker: White House
occurrences.subject: Red-dyed diesel

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal diesel excise tax statute and Treasury/IRS guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Red-dyed diesel is exempt from the federal tax of 24.4 cents a gallon that applies to regular diesel used to fuel trucks and other on-road vehicles.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Red-dyed diesel

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal fuel-tax regulations defining dyed diesel use
occurrences.quote_span: Red-dyed diesel is tax-free diesel intended for off-road vehicles, including farm and construction equipment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Red-dyed diesel

occurrences.checkable_against: State fuel-tax enforcement rules and dyed-fuel inspection procedures
occurrences.quote_span: The fuel is dyed red because it allows state law enforcement to easily spot it if drivers are using it on roads and highways in an effort to skirt taxes.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Red-dyed diesel
